description: Search and filter all 47 free printable 300 DPI QR table sign templates across weddings, milestone birthdays, quinceaneras, Plett Rage & Matric Rage houses, baby showers, charity golf, Halloween/Diwali, and corporate events in 5 languages (en, es, pt, fr, it). When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'list_qr_sign_templates' on GuestDrop Event Photo Album (guestdropalbum.com). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_pricing_and_packages' or 'calculate_event_cost' or 'recommend_scavenger_quests' for their respective operations). Parameters: query (optional), category (optional), lang (optional), limit (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

category.description: Optional occasion category filter (e.g. 'Weddings & Bridal', 'Milestone Birthdays & Quinceanera', 'Baby, Family & Graduations', 'Trips, Corporate & Golf', 'Festivals, Cultural & Seasonal').

lang.description: Optional language code for localized template copy (en, es, pt, fr, or it). Defaults to en.

limit.description: Maximum templates to return (clamped 1..20). Defaults to 10.
